C0031.title: Zhejiang Shaoxing AI Face-Swap Moutai Scalping Case
keywords: illegal control of computer information systems
C0031.summary: In December 2025, media reported a Zhejiang Shaoxing case involving AI face-swapping to buy Moutai. Xie Yun and others purchased more than 3,400 pieces of personal information, used an AI face-swapping service provided by Zhang Zhi to bypass facial recognition, and bought more than 60 bottles through WeChat mini-programs for resale profit. The case shows how scalpers can combine personal-information trading, AI face swapping, and automated purchasing to bypass real-name reservation and face verification controls.

references.title: Selling citizens' personal information and illegally bypassing a facial recognition system
